title: Réglages de l'IA de bataille
description: Fichier data/rules/battle_ai.json (lot BA6) : constantes de réglage de sim-battle/src/ai/. Lu par sim-battle (BattleAiRules).

cover_lateral.description: B6: a defensive side looks for cover this far on either side of the centre of its deployment line.

cover_ahead.description: ... this far ahead of its deployment line (towards the enemy) ...

cover_setback.description: Shooters stand this far behind a hedge, a fence or a ditch (well within [`crate::site::HEDGE_COVER_REACH`]).

cover_setbacks.description: R4: setbacks tried in turn behind a hedge on a crest (the last one still clear of the obstacle's [`OBSTACLE_REACH`]).

village_setback.description: Shooters stand this far inside the edge of a village.

shooters_ahead.description: Shooters stand this far in front of the line (the usual defensive order).

bank_setback.description: EP3: shooters hold the bank this far back from the water.

river_reach.description: EP3: a crossing farther than this from the deployment line is not held.

crossing_patience.description: EP3: an advancing side waits this long on its bank while its shooters duel with the enemy shooters covering the crossing.

crossing_exposure.description: EP3: each enemy shooter covering a crossing's far end costs this many metres of march.

bridgehead_depth.description: EP3: the line forms this far beyond a crossing.

cover_threshold.description: B6 score a cover must reach to be considered at all.

village_cover_max.description: EP6: decor areas whose missile cover is at most this good count as a defensive position (hamlets, churchyards, manors, farms).

wing_behind_foot.description: IA night: the attacker's waiting horse stands this far (metres) behind its foot's centre ...

wing_release_m.description: ... until a foot regiment is this close (metres) to an enemy one (80 m: 672 wins of 768 against the novice and the passive side, before 618; 150 m: 651, 250 m: 610).

wing_under_fire_s.description: IA night: the rule holds for a horse that took missile casualties within this many seconds (40 s: 670 wins of 768, mirrored armies unchanged and the demo's first contact still near 70 s; always: 672, but the first contact at 192 s).

charge_distance.description: Distance at which the line closes in at the run.

counter_charge_distance.description: A defensive line counter-charges enemies this close.

crest_stakes_safety.description: SG4: shooters behind their planted stakes on the military crest of a defensive position fall back when enemy foot comes this close.

shooter_safety.description: Shooters fall back when enemy melee troops come this close.

cover_safety.description: R4: shooters behind a hedge, a ditch or in a village fall back when enemy foot comes this close.

field_margin.description: Distance kept from the field's edges by the AI's moves (a move outside the field is refused).

isolation_distance.description: Enemy shooters farther than this from their own melee troops are "isolated" (a cavalry target).

cavalry_reach.description: Radius within which cavalry looks for targets.

duel_time.description: Longest archery duel before the line advances regardless (seconds).

attacker_duel_time.description: A clearly stronger attacker (its enemy stands on the defensive) gives up the archery duel after this long and closes in (F5d: two AI armies always end up engaging).

duel_range.description: The archery duel is fought when the lines stand this close (metres); EP9b: closer than this, a line closing in after the duel advances in two echelons.

duel_loss_margin.description: A side whose losses exceed the enemy's by more than this share is losing the archery duel and closes in (B4).

river_margin.description: AI destinations keep this far from the edge of deep water (F5d).

assault_range.description: Closing in, the cavalry charges enemy horse this close to the line.

attacker_patience.description: Window in which a clearly stronger attacker rides at the enemy horse to open the fight (F5d).

attacker_wait.description: A weaker attacker waits this long for the defender to come to it, then engages anyway (B4: it is the side that sought the battle; armies meet within one to three minutes).

defender_patience.description: A defensive side gives up waiting after this long ...

defender_quiet.description: ... unless nobody has fought for this long: the attacker does not come, the defender keeps its ground and lets the battle be refused (EP9, ADR 0056).

engine_patience.description: Besiegers wait for their engines at most this long before escalading.

ram_relief_crew.description: SG4: a ram whose crew falls below this share of its full crew calls a foot regiment to take it over.

ram_relief_stand.description: SG4: the relieving regiment stands this far behind the ram, away from the gate (outside the reach of the boiling oil).

assault_stall.description: SG4: an assault with no progress (ram blow, ladders, wall walk gained, tower docked, works down) for this long is abandoned.

assault_hopeless.description: SG4: an assault is abandoned when the besiegers' strength falls below this share of the garrison's (no opening, nobody on the walls).

engine_target_hp_per_m.description: SG4: engines choose the weakest front wall; each metre of distance from the engines weighs as this many HP (the nearest of equal walls).

steep_climb.description: R2b: a rise steeper than this (metres per metre over 20 m) is not charged at the run from afar: the regiment walks up and charges close.

under_fire.description: R2b: a regiment hit by missiles within this many seconds is under fire.

line_slack.description: R2b: a line regiment this far ahead of the line's centre waits for it.

close_charge.description: R2b: below this distance a regiment charges whatever the slope.

pursuit_leash.description: B8: horsemen give up a pursuit once the routing target has fled this far from the battle line's anchor, and fall back to it instead.

detour_hops.description: B8: dense bocage can chain several hedges between a horse and its target; this many are tried in turn before giving up and waiting.

detour_clearance.description: B6: horsemen ride this far past the end of a hedge before charging.

detour_depth.description: RJ-a: ... and this far out on the target's side, so that the charge is not ridden along the hedge (within its reach it would break; the old 10 m only worked while an instant wedge lengthened the riders' reach).

hold_height.description: R2b: a defender this much higher than the enemy (mean ground under the regiments, metres) holds its heights ...

hold_ratio.description: ... unless it is this much stronger.

rescue_distance.description: R4: a defensive line regiment helps its shooters in a melee this close.

post_run.description: R4: shooters run to the military crest when the enemy is this close.

receive_distance.description: R4: a defender receives an enemy marching on it from this close.

attacker_hold_time.description: R4: an attacker above an enemy of shooters waits at most this long.

shooter_army.description: R4: ... when shooters make more than this share of the enemy's power.

advance_lean_max.description: B8: within the forward arc, the line leans this many metres (at most) towards a defender offset sideways from dead ahead, instead of marching straight past it. A defender squarely in front (`dx` ~ 0) is unaffected.

relief_leans.description: R2b: lateral shifts tried for each step of an advancing line.

relief_saving.description: R2b: a shifted step must save this much march (metres) to be taken.

race_margin.description: R4: the own line must reach a position in less than this share of the time the nearest enemy needs to get there.

ground_margin.description: R4: a spot of the heights must beat the deployment spot by this much.

cover_lateral_cost.description: R4: a cover away from the deployment line costs this much per metre aside and in depth (B6's distance penalty, in points of height).

weak_point.description: R4: metres of lateral offset a line regiment accepts to strike an enemy holding one point less of ground ([`score_position`]).

firing_laterals.description: R2b: lateral offsets of the firing spots tried by a shooter.

exposure_cost.description: R2b: a firing spot within reach of this many enemy shooters costs this much march (metres) each.

shooter_guard.description: SG4: enemy horse this close to one of our shooters draws our horse's counter-charge.

stakes_guard.description: R2b: horsemen keep this far from the front of planted stakes.
